goal: Correct account rule toggle status and Save feedback when ON has no pending replacement. Frontend-only change; derive work from existing persisted intent fields; no server operations, SQL or backend change.
context: Live four accounts have apply_to_existing=true, revision=0, replacement_revision=null, shrink_pending=false, waiting_droplet_id=null, status=FUTURE_ONLY. This means only toggle was enabled and no spec change queued. Show ON / No replacement queued, explain enabling alone does not replace. Save feedback must use refreshed account state or explicitly say status unavailable. Pending/replacement/started deletion statuses remain visible; hide stale next_action_at if no pending intent. Preserve Desired semantics, all saved settings, backend API/worker and actual servers. Test unknown state, ON idle, active rollout, OFF admitted deletion and HTML escaping. Independent lifecycle network stalls are diagnostic only.
commit_message: fix(accounts): show actual pending rule work in status and save feedback
